landing.faq.items.ai.a.en: It writes only from what is in your profile and the job ad. When something is missing, it asks you instead of inventing it. You always review your CV before you use it.

landing.faq.items.ai.q.en: Does the AI make things up?

landing.faq.items.data.a.en: Your profile is used to give you the service: matching, quizzes and CVs. Read the privacy policy for what is stored, why, and how to have it deleted.

landing.faq.items.experience.a.en: No. Students and graduates can add education, projects and volunteering, verify their skills, and find entry-level jobs.

landing.faq.items.free.a.en: Yes. Every feature is free for everyone, with no subscriptions or payments.

landing.faq.items.language.a.en: Yes. The whole app is in English and Somali, and you choose the language of each CV separately.

landing.faq.items.language.q.en: Can I use it in Somali?

landing.faq.items.when.q.en: When can I download the app?

landing.faq.items.where.a.en: Jobs in Somaliland and Somalia, and remote jobs open to people there, from job sources whose terms allow it and from company or NGO career pages you add.

landing.features.cv.body.en: Reads the job ad and writes a CV that shows your matching experience, in the language you choose. It tells you what information is missing instead of making it up.

landing.features.jobs.body.en: Searches job sources that allow it, keeps each job once, and scores how relevant it is to your profile. The score is about fit, not your chance of being hired.

landing.features.more.en: Also in the app: interview practice with feedback, saved jobs, alerts for new strong matches, and reports on your progress.

landing.features.skills.body.en: Short adaptive quizzes for your skills. Your result level is separate from what you said about yourself, so employers and you see the difference.

landing.features.subtitle.en: They work from your own profile and real job ads. Nothing is invented.

landing.features.title.en: Three AI helpers in one app

landing.legal.draft.en: Draft: this text will be reviewed before the app launches.

landing.legal.privacy.sections.ai.p.en: Some features send text to an AI service to write or check content (for example a job ad, or a quiz topic). We send only what the feature needs. By default, an admin setting blocks personal profile details from being sent to AI.

landing.legal.privacy.sections.contact.p.en: Questions about this policy: use the contact details shown in the app once it launches.

landing.legal.privacy.sections.keep.p.en: While your account exists. When an account is deleted, its profile, CVs, quizzes, saved jobs, notifications and usage records are deleted too. Waitlist emails are deleted when they are no longer needed for the launch email, or when you ask.

landing.legal.privacy.sections.rights.p.en: You can change your profile at any time, turn notifications off, and ask us to show, correct or delete your information.

landing.legal.privacy.sections.share.p.en: You, and a small number of KOBANIQ administrators who look after the service. Every administrator action is recorded. We share information with service providers (hosting, database, email, push notifications, AI) only to run KOBANIQ.

landing.legal.privacy.sections.what.p.en: Your account (email, language, password stored only as a secure hash), the profile you write (education, experience, skills, preferences), your quiz results, the job ads you add, the CVs you create, and simple usage records of AI requests (which feature, when, and size; never the content). From this website: only the email, optional name and language you give in the waitlist form.

landing.legal.privacy.sections.who.p.en: KOBANIQ is a career app for people in Somaliland and Somalia. This policy explains what information we keep, why, and your choices.

landing.legal.privacy.sections.why.p.en: Only to give you the service: matching jobs to your profile, scoring quizzes, writing CVs, sending the notifications you allow, and keeping the service safe and working. We do not sell your information.

landing.legal.terms.sections.ai.p.en: CVs, quiz results and match scores are help, not guarantees. Check every CV before you send it. A match score shows how relevant a job is to your profile, not your chance of being hired.

landing.legal.terms.sections.changes.p.en: We may update the app and these terms. Important changes will be shown in the app.

landing.legal.terms.sections.content.p.en: What you write stays yours. You allow KOBANIQ to use it to give you the service, for example to write a CV from your profile.

landing.legal.terms.sections.fair.p.en: Do not misuse the service, try to break it, or collect other people's information. To keep the free AI features working for everyone, very heavy use may be slowed down for a while.

landing.legal.terms.sections.jobs.p.en: Jobs come from other websites and employers. KOBANIQ does not employ, recruit or check employers. Apply on the employer's own page and be careful with any request for money.

landing.legal.terms.sections.use.p.en: KOBANIQ is free. You need to be old enough to work in your country and to give true information about yourself. Keep your password private.

mobile.jobs.research.intro.en: Searches the sources you choose now. It runs in the background and can take a minute.

mobile.jobs.research.linksHint.en: Up to {{max}} public career pages (one per line). Only pages that publish job data and allow it are read.

mobile.jobs.research.linksNeeded.en: Add at least one career-page link.

mobile.jobs.research.noSources.en: No job source can be searched for these regions right now.

mobile.jobs.results.lowerBody.en: These jobs fit you less well. Each one says why.

mobile.jobs.results.noneBody.en: None of these jobs fits your skills and experience well enough. We don’t show jobs that don’t fit as if they did.

mobile.jobs.results.scoreNote.en: The score shows how relevant the job is to your profile, not your chance of being hired.

mobile.jobs.run.failed.en: No source could be read this time. Try again later.

mobile.jobs.run.hiddenByFilters_one.en: {{count}} job found did not match your filters (it is kept for later searches).

mobile.jobs.run.hiddenByFilters_other.en: {{count}} jobs found did not match your filters (they are kept for later searches).

mobile.jobs.run.status.failed.en: The sources could not be read.

mobile.jobs.run.status.partial.en: Some sources could not be read; the others were checked.

mobile.jobs.run.summary.en: {{found}} jobs found in total, {{new}} of them not seen before by KOBANIQ.

mobile.jobs.run.wait.en: You can leave this screen; the search keeps going.

mobile.jobs.saveFailed.en: Could not change your saved jobs. Try again.

mobile.jobs.savedEmptyBody.en: Tap Save on a job to keep it here.

mobile.jobs.schedule.emptyBody.en: In “Find new jobs”, tick “Repeat this search automatically” to search every hour, day or week.

mobile.jobs.schedule.note.en: The search runs by itself at this time, in your phone’s time zone. Results appear under Schedules.

mobile.jobs.schedule.off.en: Switched off: it will not run.

mobile.jobs.schedule.saved.en: Schedule saved. It runs by itself at the time shown below.

mobile.jobs.schedule.skips.busy.en: Last time it did not run: another of your searches was still running.

mobile.jobs.schedule.skips.error.en: Last time it could not start. It will try again next time.

mobile.jobs.schedule.skips.no_sources.en: Last time it did not run: its job sources are switched off right now.

mobile.jobs.search.intro.en: Searches the jobs KOBANIQ has already found. Only open jobs are shown.

mobile.jobs.search.noneStoredBody.en: KOBANIQ only shows real jobs it has found. Try other filters, or start a new search of the job sources.

mobile.jobs.search.noneStoredTitle.en: No stored jobs match these filters

mobile.jobs.search.regionsHint.en: None chosen: your preferred regions. Remote jobs are always included.

mobile.jobs.subtitle.en: Find jobs that fit your skills and experience, with the reasons.

mobile.notifications.emailUnavailable.en: Email notifications are not switched on for KOBANIQ yet. Your choice is kept for when they are.

mobile.notifications.emptyBody.en: When a job search finds a new job that fits you well, it appears here.

mobile.notifications.pushUnavailable.en: Push is not set up in this version of the app yet. New matches still appear in this list.

mobile.notifications.rowDetail.en: New strong job matches · push and email

mobile.notifications.subtitle.en: New jobs that fit you well, found by your job searches.

mobile.preview.job.explanation.en: Matches 4 of 5 required skills: React Native, TypeScript, Git, REST APIs.

mobile.profile.deleteConfirm.en: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.

mobile.profile.hints.contactEmail.en: Shown on your CVs. Your login email does not change.

mobile.profile.hints.endDate.en: Leave empty if you still work here

mobile.profile.itemGone.en: This entry no longer exists. Go back to see your list.

mobile.profile.languageError.generic.en: The language changed on this phone, but it could not be saved to your account. Please choose it again.

mobile.profile.languageError.network.en: The language changed on this phone, but it could not be saved to your account. Check your internet connection and choose it again.

mobile.profile.languageHint.en: The app and messages from KOBANIQ use this language on all your devices.

mobile.profile.loadError.en: Your profile could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.

mobile.profile.personalHint.en: Employers see this on your CVs. Only you can see and change it.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.languages.en: Languages you speak and how well.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.preferences.en: What kind of job you are looking for. Job research uses this.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.projects.en: Things you built or worked on.

mobile.quiz.cancelled.en: This quiz was cancelled. Your skill did not change.

mobile.quiz.disclaimer.en: Quiz results measure knowledge, not proof of real-world experience.

mobile.quiz.leave.text.en: Leave the quiz? Your answers are kept and you can continue later, or cancel it.

mobile.quiz.notFound.en: This quiz could not be found.

mobile.quiz.report.harder.en: Try the quiz again at a harder level.

mobile.quiz.report.levelNote.en: Saved on your {{skill}} skill. Your own rating stays as you set it.

mobile.quiz.report.noGaps.en: No gaps found in this quiz.

mobile.quiz.report.noStrengths.en: No topic fully right this time.

mobile.quiz.report.practise.en: Practise {{topic}}, then take the quiz again.

mobile.quiz.start.adaptiveHint.en: The questions adapt: three right answers in a row make them harder; after a wrong answer you get another question on the same topic.

mobile.quiz.start.noSkills.en: Add a skill first, then you can take a quiz on it.

mobile.quiz.start.privacy.en: Only the skill name is sent to the AI, never your profile.

mobile.quiz.start.subtitle.en: A short, optional quiz to confirm one of your skills.

mobile.quiz.start.writing.en: The AI is writing your questions. This can take up to a minute.

mobile.reports.loadError.en: Your report could not be loaded. Pull down to try again.

mobile.reports.note.en: Every number is counted from your saved activity — nothing is estimated. Applications are not counted: you apply on the employer’s own site. Days start at midnight in your time zone ({{timeZone}}).

mobile.reports.subtitle.en: Your activity in KOBANIQ, counted from what you saved.

mobile.skills.emptyBody.en: Add the skills you have and rate them yourself. Later, a short optional quiz can confirm them.

mobile.skills.formHint.en: This is your own rating. A quiz can confirm it later; your rating stays as you set it.

mobile.skills.loadError.en: Your skills could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.

mobile.skills.onlyQuiz.en: Only a quiz changes the assessed level. It measures knowledge, not work experience.

mobile.skills.quizThis.en: Take a quiz on this skill

mobile.skills.suggestBody.en: A short quiz can confirm your level. It is always optional.

mobile.soon.jobs.body.en: Soon you can choose regions and job sources in Somaliland and Somalia and get jobs that match you, each with an explanation.

mobile.soon.reports.body.en: Reports on your CVs, tests and job searches appear once you start using those features.

server.email.resetPassword.body.en:
Hello,

Your KOBANIQ password reset code is: {{code}}

Enter it in the app to choose a new password. The code works for {{minutes}} minutes.

If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.

KOBANIQ

server.email.verifyEmail.body.en:
Hello,

Your KOBANIQ verification code is: {{code}}

Enter it in the app to confirm your email. The code works for {{minutes}} minutes.

If you did not create a KOBANIQ account, you can ignore this email.

KOBANIQ
